name: realimpact_material_mfcc_logmel

output.scores: SVM margins (binary [-margin,+margin], multiclass sklearn OVR); NOT calibrated probabilities
output.class_index: index into classes; use this rather than score argmax for SVC vote ties

contract.waveform: 1s peak20ms-centered16kHz; YCB decode and resample; RealImpact force-deconvolved48kHz->16kHz then .95 peak normalize
contract.license: RealImpact code/data/checkpoint permissions require separate review
limits: Deterministic first30 rows represent nearby microphones/positions and mostly one source vertex, not independent diverse impacts. Whole physical objects are held out.
Plastic bowls are same product family at different sizes; material and shape remain confounded.
Three objects/class and nine scored objects give high uncertainty; no universal or phone accuracy claim.
Force-deconvolved preprocessed impulse responses are not raw phone tapping audio; gain calibration unavailable, so per-clip normalization applied.
Partial DEFLATE decompression verified shape/finite complete rows and hashed prefixes; full-member/archive CRC or complete-file SHA256 NOT verified. Small annotation members have CRC verified.
No iPhone or mobile conversion measured; source dataset redistribution permission requires review.

training.selection: all-data training-only object-rank CV; no outer-score family winner

performance_claim: Deployment fitted on every cached observation. No deployment training-set accuracy presented as held-out performance.

verification_fixture.schema: features float32[N,D], scores float64[N,K], class_index int32[N], classes[K], source_indices[N]; <=8 real rows
